goal: An authenticated user can create a private note that survives a new session.
scope: Web UI note creation and persistence; authentication implementation is unchanged.
preconditions: Two disposable users, Alice and Bob, in separate accounts
Alice starts with an empty note list
The controller supplies a fixed candidate URL and isolated data namespace

criteria.outcome: Alice can create a note through the UI and see the entered title and body.
criteria.observation_boundary: Observe the submitted content in the note list and detail view.

criteria.outcome: The created note retains its title and body after reload and a new authenticated browser session.
criteria.observation_boundary: Read the same record through the UI after each session boundary.

criteria.outcome: Submitting an empty title does not create a note and shows a visible explanation.
criteria.observation_boundary: Observe the explanation and confirm the list still contains only valid prior notes.

criteria.outcome: Bob cannot see Alice's note in his list or read its content by opening its URL.
criteria.observation_boundary: Use Bob's distinct browser session for both list and direct navigation.

suggestions: Visual polish beyond readable and operable controls is outside this example's required acceptance.
